verses.raw: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
verses.text: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

verses.raw: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
verses.text: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

verses.raw: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation<sup foot_note=257100>1</sup> for the companions of the Blaze.
verses.text: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
